1085: // ChunkSnapshot creates a snapshot of all the series and tombstones in the head.
1086: // It deletes the old chunk snapshots if the chunk snapshot creation is successful.

1089: // using the WAL package. N is the last WAL segment present during snapshotting and
1090: // M is the offset in segment N upto which data was written.
1091: //
1092: // The snapshot first contains all series (each in individual records and not sorted), followed by
1093: // tombstones (a single record), and finally exemplars (>= 1 record). Exemplars are in the order they
1094: // were written to the circular buffer.
